payload.summary: Refined ri-06 into a post-persist policy-pause route through the existing supervise gate router. Exact-result application parks and releases the attempt before gate evaluation; policy pauses map to escalate_resume, while pending_gate and quarantine semantics remain unchanged.

decisions.title: Route after durable delegated apply
decisions.rationale: The existing resolve_parked resume CAS requires a persisted parked attempt and released lease.

decisions.title: Reuse gate_router.resolve_parked
decisions.rationale: Keeps TRUST_POSTURE evaluation, notification, audit, prior-record reuse, mirror projection, and authorized resume behind the one established seam.
